pivot_reason: State-first hazard was predictable but direction was weak; even a non-tradable perfect-label upper bound did not consistently reach the target at 1% risk. Direction information is moved from a single-asset classifier to simultaneous cross-asset liquidity structure.
economic_hypothesis: BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP share systemic liquidity shocks. A unique sweep/reclaim against peer non-confirmation is a reversal state, while broad peer breakouts with one non-breaking but flow-aligned laggard are a catch-up continuation state.

arms.UNIQUE_SWEEP_REVERSAL: exactly one asset sweeps a prior external high/low and closes back inside while at least the preregistered number of peers do not confirm the sweep; trade the sweeper toward the range
arms.BREADTH_BREAK_LAGGARD: at least the preregistered number of peer assets close beyond the same prior boundary; among non-breakers trade the asset with the strongest aligned taker flow

information_and_execution: identical to the corrected attention-liquidity evaluator: completed 5-minute bars, next open, structural price-risk target, actual funding, same-bar stop first, gap stop at actual open, global one position, no forced period close
